summary: Restore the adoption adapter from a saved immutable transaction subject before attempting fresh planning against a partially or fully changed checkout

delivery.outcome: Publish a regression-tested restart fix through independent exact-head review without granting authority from the saved plan
nonGoals: Live consumer migration, package release or fleet deployment
Automatic repair of partial writes, bypassing fresh authorization or shared configuration changes

architecture.decision: Allow an explicitly supplied existing AdoptionPlan for reconstruction and authoritative observation. Validate caller subject bindings; retain fresh planner comparison and delegated authority before every adoption write. Exercise interruption and disk-journal reopening on isolated Git fixtures.
interfaceChanges: Optional resume_plan argument on the existing GoalAdoptionAdapter constructor
architecture.rollback: Disable the optional resume entry point and retain the saved journal for independent reconciliation. Never retry an uncertain migration through the new-transaction constructor.

validation.evidence: After interrupted partial, complete or committed fixture writes, reconstruct the adapter and reopen the durable transaction without a second adoption effect
Foreign resume subjects and malformed bindings refuse construction; changed scope or checkout cannot authorize adoption, while delegate readback and subsequent phases remain available
Managed governance, full stack checks and independent exact-head publication preserve all required gates
